card.name: Motion or appearance verbs in scenic description
card.fires_on: Verbs of motion or visual appearance, such as rising, soaring, speeding, look, or flaming, in vivid descriptive narrative or travel writing. It also fires on small words that follow such verbs.

modes.label: Motion verbs
modes.description: A participle describing something moving through space or scenery.
modes.example: with the mist-covered mountains<< rising>> in the distance, you really do feel

modes.label: Look-like comparisons
modes.description: A verb or word that introduces a visual comparison or description of how something appears.

modes.label: Small words after visual verbs
modes.description: A small word like the or a right after a verb of showing, capturing or breaking.
modes.example: It shows the rover as<< a>> bright, boxy vehicle at the end

card.plain: It marks lively scene-setting text where something is moving or looks like something else.
